entryPoints: Run through the specified native Wrath paths in B/D. Sample numeric state models supplement the native tests.

cases.setup: L=5, Int modifier +2, Abjuration and Transmutation known, new rest cycle
actions: Invest Abjuration 4 and Transmutation 2
Attempt Mind Barrier before locking
Lock
Activate Mind Barrier through standard resource payment
expected: Before lock G=1, R=4/2, U=0 and no Warding Talisman
Pre-lock use pays zero and applies no effect
After lock Mind Barrier gives 10 absorption for its native duration and deducts exactly 1 Abjuration point
After use G=1, R=3/2, U=1 and Warding Talisman remains +2 resistance

actions: Replenish Abjuration once
On a full school with a separate fixture where G≥1, try Replenish again
Try Invest and Reset after lock
Try changing the physical resonance choice
expected: First replenish G=0, R=4/2, U=1 and preserved snapshots
Full, locked Invest/Reset and attribute change paths preserve the state

cases.setup: L=8, G=3, A[Abjuration]=2, R[Abjuration]=0, valid locked Abjuration snapshot
actions: Invoke Mind Barrier from valid ability
Call read-only availability repeatedly
Restore one Abjuration point with Replenish then invoke Mind Barrier
Re-enter the same execution callback
expected: Insufficient school balance cannot use the generic fallback and changes no state
A valid use consumes one, the duplicate event consumes zero
Resonance stays present at R=0

cases.setup: L=8, Int +2; G=4 after locking/spending, record rest id
actions: Save/reload, reattach resource facts, remove/reapply projection buffs
Apply temporary Int and expire it
Complete one successful rest twice by the same event id
expected: Day, balances, spent and existing snapshot survive reload and reattachment
Temporary Int cannot refill
Rest once gives B=G=10, zero ordinary allocation and no active old resonance

actions: Use Repower Construct on a valid construct corpse
Attempt the same corpse again
Reset twice
expected: Valid use costs G=1 exactly, fails target check on second use and consumes nothing
After both resets G=9, U=1, R=0; corpse consumption recorded separately from owner

cases.setup: Trappings chosen and locked, ordinary R Abjuration=2, Transmutation=2, both snapshots≥1
actions: Run one native approved Counterstrike and repeat the same attack event
Spend through a multi-point Panoply test action using the same adapter
Attempt an unaffordable transaction
expected: First cost 1 uses Abjuration tie position, repeat consumes zero
A cost-2 plan from R=1/2 takes Transmutation then Abjuration, leaves 0/1
Unaffordable plan changes no member or generic balance; snapshots stay

cases.setup: Mage's Paraphernalia selected; Divination, Evocation and Necromancy invested and locked
actions: Arm Spell Power +2 at L=11
Cast qualifying spell from 0099 book
Cast from Psychic book and item
Try +3 at L=11 and again at L=12
Try primary effect with insufficient payment
expected: Arming costs zero; qualifying cast costs 2 and CL increases by 2
Foreign and item casts have normal params and no debit
At 12 +3 costs 3; invalid/insufficient trigger gives no follow-on effect

cases.setup: L=20, Int modifier +5; Mastery Abjuration, A=2 and R=2 for Abjuration, H=4; eligible locked groups
actions: Read Mind Barrier, class list and separate school's power params
Use Mind Barrier
Pay one Trappings cost
Attempt Respec to another school then commit
expected: Mind Barrier effective L=24, capacity 48; matching save DC 27, other ordinary focus DC 25; book CL remains 20
Mind Barrier uses H first (H=3, R=2)
Trappings leaves H=3
Respec carries T=1 into new mastery with at most 3 remaining, removes old mastery-only contributions

cases.setup: Locked Abjuration R=3, U=1, second same-school slot selected
actions: Discard preview that would remove both slots
Commit removal of Extra Spells only
Remove last Abjuration slot while locked
Respec out and back into 0099 on same day
expected: Discard leaves live state byte-for-byte equivalent
Extra Spells removal preserves school state
Last removal invalidates Abjuration and dependent Panoplies; Q increases by 3
No new daily budget or free old snapshot

cases.setup: Unit A is Occultist 5/Psychic 4; unit B is Occultist 1; an unrelated owner has the same action icon
actions: Spend and reset A through native entries
Check B, Psychic Phrenic and unrelated original resources
Inspect ranks and DCs
Try a zero-capacity owner
expected: B and foreign resources are untouched
Occultist effects scale from 5, phrenic pool uses its own rules
Budget floor 0, no negative or free spend

cases.setup: Already armed spend-on-cast, invalidated target or activation and three member pools
actions: Check CanPay then change balance before execution
Raise a duplicate cast or callback
Remove a required Panoply member after authorization
Trigger StickyTouch delivery
expected: Execution rechecks and fails atomically
Same execution identity is charged at most once
Invalidated source does not pay or grant effect
StickyTouch delivers a previously paid use

cases.setup: New Occultist at level 1, Abjuration first and then Abjuration (Extra Spells)
actions: Try Extra Spells before first selection
Select two valid slots in order
Pick MageShield and Warding Weapon from private level 1 list
Try third Abjuration later
expected: Extra Spells unavailable until first slot is set
One base power and one school resource
Two roots known at level 1 and exactly six fixed knacks
Third Abjuration selection rejected

actions: Level 4 activates two level-2 selections (Allied Cloak and Resist Energy). Level 16 requests two level-6 selections; pick Globe of Invulnerability for first slot.
expected: No level-2 quota before level 4
At 4 each slot gains one valid selection and separate provenance
At 16 duplicate root and other levels are excluded, second slot remains empty

cases.setup: One Abjuration slot, MageShield sourced there and via another legal same-book grant; mixed Wizard also knows MageShield
actions: Cancel removal in preview
Commit replacing Abjuration slot
Remove another same-book source
expected: Cancel restores old quota and data
Other same-book source and Wizard source survive class-slot removal
Last same-book source removed; Wizard side survives

cases.setup: New Occultist with two slots at level 1 and more at 2 and 6
actions: Pick Abjuration and Transmutation
Select Trappings on 2 and try duplicate
Test Mage's Paraphernalia with 2/3 and 3/3 members
Lose one of Trappings' members
expected: Trappings at 2 gives one union selection per castable level
Duplicate barred
Mage's first legal at 6 after all 3 prerequisite schools
Loss invalidates derived quotas and corresponding known sources

actions: Inspect 143 A rows and roots, variants, schools and DLC guards
Learn Hideous Laughter, Mass Daze, Lesser Animate Dead, Control Construct and Spirit-Bound Blade from appropriate known schools
expected: Known levels are 1, 4, 2, 6 and 4 respectively for 0099
Spirit-Bound Blade is Transmutation only
Any backlink or global spell list data from baseline is unchanged

cases.setup: Provider file loads three modes; existing save learned Fire Shield from Evocation
actions: Register with no provider, disabled provider, active provider, then active but one broken child
Restore actual valid provider and reload
expected: First two modes skip Fire Shield from new choices
Valid active root takes one L4 choice and exposes both variants
Broken child excludes root; no free spell replacement
Same saved root/provenance resolves and can be used again

cases.setup: Psychic/Occultist shares spell GUID on each private book; other item uses that GUID
actions: Learn and cast from each book at its own level
Use Center Self and test thought/emotion and Logical using each intended book
Attempt Psychic-only amplifications, undercast and discipline effects with 0099 book
Use shared item ability
expected: 0099 known grants, slots and CL remain private
Shared thought/emotion applies only to intended psychic casts
Psychic-only additions continue to require their specific book
Item keeps native behavior

cases.setup: Fresh cache missing one mandatory donor; signed unchanged foreign GUID collision fixture
actions: Attempt full registration
Repeat after injecting correct donor
Reload with completion twice
expected: Missing donor or collision leaves 0099 unavailable and foreign data intact
Complete map registers exactly one class entry, one spellbook and complete choices
No duplicate registrations, replacement or lingering preview ledger
